records.jsonl.purpose: One coherent valid example of every v1 record type

integrity_report.json.purpose: Expected offline collection-integrity result with explicit not-checked warnings

../../../record_contract_fixtures.py.purpose: Deterministic fixture builder and invalid-case mutation base

invalid_case_coverage: candidate without signal or valid transition
reassessment without a new candidate version
composite score without an explicit versioned rule
Mantis candidate creation without an independent signal
Mantis credential-like host or incomplete success receipt
orphan, duplicate, and competing record identities
snapshot membership omission and unauthorized cross-snapshot reference
ownership, evidence-span, temporal-eligibility, and cycle mismatch
local artifact hash, size, path, and exact passage occurrence mismatch

validation_boundary.step_1_3: Record-local syntax, types, semantic conditions, IDs, hashes, within-record chronology, policy versions, and scientific boundaries
validation_boundary.step_1_4: Implemented collection-wide existence, ownership, snapshot closure, lineage, collision, chronology, artifact, and passage-offset validation; migrations require an explicit registered path and a future atomic collection migrator

notes: The fixture is not evidence and contains no real paper text or personal data.
Syntactically valid orphan references are intentionally accepted locally so Step 1.3 does not pretend to perform Step 1.4 checks.
Remote fixture artifacts are never fetched by offline validation and therefore produce explicit not-checked warnings.
The records are not wired into the current production pipeline or legacy Mantis CSV exporter.
